_comment: Hand-labelled hard cases for the stance classifier, relabelled for stance v4
(2026-09-30): `expected` is whether the item is good or bad news for
Kosovo's image abroad. Quotes count: a foreign leader denying Kosovo's
statehood is negative even when the outlet only reports it.
`v3` records the old outlet-voice label, so the change of definition is visible.
`must_not_be` is the hard assertion: a case may be arguable against
neutral, but flipping good news to bad (or the reverse) is the defect this
